name: Fine-Line Circuits Limited
about: Fine-Line Circuits Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of printed circuit boards (PCBs) in India. The company offers on-board, high frequency microwave hybrid, multilayer cavity, flex and rigid flex, oversized/backplane, high copper, multilayer impedance controlled blind/buried, embedded passive component, and multilayer PCBs. It also provides various equipment, including automated optical inspection, bonding, CNC equipment, plasma activation, electroless PTH and direct metallization, imaging, etching, P.I.S.M, and bare board testing equipment. Fine-Line Circuits Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
